prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production bitmap asset for a Chinese finance talking-head explainer. Entirely original conceptual illustration, not evidence or a museum reproduction. No people, logos, currency numerals, text, letters, UI, watermark or labels. Nothing touches an outer edge. Rich visible material behavior at phone viewing scale, clear silhouette, elegant restrained composition. The real presenter is supplied separately and must not appear in this asset. Square transparent RGBA sprite atlas. Exactly four fully separate objects on a 2 by 2 grid, large transparent cross gutters and generous transparent outer margin: top left a simple shopping tote bag with handle; top right two overlapping blank coins; bottom left a shield with a single check cutout or mark; bottom right a heavy round-holed weight. These four objects do not overlap each other; no secondary fragments in the gaps. Front readable view, unified soft top-left light. Medium: convincing macro textile patchwork assemblage, NOT embroidered icons and NOT fuzzy felt. Each symbol is assembled from several visibly different woven cotton remnants: terracotta gingham, faded indigo stripes, pale ochre linen, muted olive checks. Geometric fabric panels with visible seams, turned seam allowances and sparse straight joining stitches; thickness where patches join, tiny textile shadows. The color patches construct each object rather than being printed pictures on flat cloth. Keep holes genuinely open and edges clean enough to isolate. Avoid dense cross-stitch outlines, fluffy wool and metallic shine.
